identity.description: Private study of the supplied standard-outfit character, not a cleared original production character.
invariants: Light-blue long hair with a high looped top section
Dark-blue spherical hair ornament with gold accents
Retain the accepted face geometry, not merely hair and eye colour

costume.description: Only the standard costume. Ornate and summer references are excluded. Hidden back construction must be decided before approval.
invariants: Navy fitted sleeveless bodice, pale trim and green throat bow
Detached white sleeves with navy cuffs and gold upper-arm bands
Pleated navy skirt with gold hem trim
White upper-leg stockings and navy boots with gold top trim

style.description: Clean anime contours and cel-like shading.
invariants: Retain line weight and restrained cel shading; plain neutral review background.
